name: agent-report-card
description: A letter-grade report card for your Claude Code or Codex setup. Runs locally and sends nothing.

interface.shortDescription: Grade your AI coding setup in two minutes.
interface.longDescription: Checks your rules files, context load, memory, safety settings and project setup, then gives you a letter grade and the top three fixes in a local HTML page. Read-only. Nothing leaves your computer.
capabilities: Top three fixes in plain words
defaultPrompt: Give my AI coding setup a report card.
Grade my AGENTS.md and Codex settings.
